description: cleanup: tabadmintest revokes its own ego.table.admin grant on t{{PERMTESTID}} (using its own token, still authorized at the moment this request is evaluated -- see authorizedForTablePermissions' doc comment for why a caller can always act on a table it currently administers, including revoking its own standing). This also doubles as one more DATA-SECURITY-2.md finding #4 regression: DeletePermissions' route no longer requires identity-wide ego.dsn.admin either. Needed so perm-83 later in this test group sees the exact grant count it expects on t{{PERMTESTID}} -- leaving this grant behind would otherwise leak into that count.
